# User acquisition skills by Vlad Yasinski

> Twenty-seven open agent skills (SKILL.md) for paid user acquisition, paywalls, onboarding funnels, unit economics, attribution, marketing system audits, typed AI decision gates and a Claude + Jev competitor creative system, budget planning, server-side tracking, anomaly alerts and ad production pipelines in app and subscription businesses. Written by Vlad Yasinski, AI growth consultant in Warsaw, Poland, 10+ years in paid acquisition. MIT licence.

Install: `npx skills add ua5er/user-acquisition-skills`

## Live tools (free, in the browser)

- [Free ad creative checker](https://www.roimobi.com/tools/ad-checker?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms&utm_campaign=user-acquisition-skills): paste ad copy, get a score from 0 to 100 and the fixes, most important first
- [Free synthetic audience ad test](https://www.roimobi.com/tools/synthetic-audience-ad-test?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms&utm_campaign=user-acquisition-skills): one ad or two shown to 1,000 virtual people; funnel per 1,000 virtual impressions, objections, verdict

## Skills

- [ua-kill-scale-rules](skills/ua-kill-scale-rules/SKILL.md): kill, scale and pacing rules for Meta and TikTok
- [paywall-audit](skills/paywall-audit/SKILL.md): paywall and checkout audit with a test queue
- [onboarding-web2app-funnel](skills/onboarding-web2app-funnel/SKILL.md): onboarding and web-to-app concepts
- [unit-economics-check](skills/unit-economics-check/SKILL.md): CAC, cohort LTV, payback, safe CAC ceiling
- [attribution-sanity-check](skills/attribution-sanity-check/SKILL.md): reconcile platform, MMP, SKAN and backend data
- [creative-testing-research](skills/creative-testing-research/SKILL.md): creative testing and public ad library research
- [weekly-ua-report](skills/weekly-ua-report/SKILL.md): weekly acquisition report that ends in decisions
- [ai-marketing-system-audit](skills/ai-marketing-system-audit/SKILL.md): marketing loop audit
- [meta-ads-learning-audit](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/meta-ads-learning-audit): audit a Meta account stuck in learning and write a post-mortem of past campaigns
- [meta-ads-launch-planner](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/meta-ads-launch-planner): plan a Meta launch that exits learning, with budget math, rules and a scaling schedule
- [meta-creative-testing](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/meta-creative-testing): creative testing for Meta after Andromeda, with winner and kill criteria and briefs
- [jev-marketing-gates](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/jev-marketing-gates): typed decision gates with Jev for ad copy checks, comment triage, policy pre-checks and creative tagging; propose, judge, decide in code, approve by a person
- [competitor-creative-parser](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/competitor-creative-parser): Claude + Jev step 1, parse competitor static and video ads into a tagged dataset and a market snapshot; Claude drafts a market taxonomy for the category before tagging
- [market-to-creative-brief](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/market-to-creative-brief): Claude + Jev step 2, production decisions plus a static brief and a motion brief tied to snapshot numbers
- [creative-preflight-panel](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/creative-preflight-panel): Claude + Jev step 3, simulated buyer panel with go, rework or drop per concept and a calibration check against real results
- [synthetic-audience-panel](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/synthetic-audience-panel): Claude + Jev, one ad or two shown to about 1,000 virtual people in a few requests; funnel per 1,000, objections, readings by kind of person and a verdict for two ads; panel answers, not a forecast
- [ua-budget-planner](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/ua-budget-planner): Builds a monthly or quarterly UA budget and channel mix from target CAC, payback window and cash limits, with a test reserve, a payer and payback forecast and a scenario table.
- [apple-search-ads-playbook](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/apple-search-ads-playbook): Builds an Apple Search Ads account for subscription apps: brand, category, competitor and discovery campaigns, match types and negatives, bids from cost per payer, custom product pages, AdServices attribution and a weekly loop.
- [google-app-campaigns-playbook](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/google-app-campaigns-playbook): Plans Google App campaigns: install, in-app action or tROAS bidding by event volume, event import from Firebase or an MMP, asset groups and ratings, budget steps, learning period and iOS versus Android.
- [tiktok-app-campaigns-playbook](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/tiktok-app-campaigns-playbook): Sets up TikTok app and web campaigns: optimisation event, Smart+ versus manual, Events API and MMP check, creative cadence, Spark Ads, cost cap versus lowest cost, scaling and fatigue signals.
- [aso-store-listing](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/aso-store-listing): Plans App Store and Google Play listing work: keyword research and field allocation, screenshot and video order, custom product pages and experiments, ratings prompts, localisation priority and page view to install measurement.
- [ad-copy-production](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/ad-copy-production): A pipeline for ad text at volume: angles, hook bank, per-platform copy with limits, cheap-model drafts with strong-model editing, claim and policy checks, naming, test plan and cost line.
- [payment-capi-tracking](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/payment-capi-tracking): Designs server-side purchase events from Stripe, RevenueCat or Adapty to Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API: click ids, dedup, value, refunds, web2app, QA plan.
- [spend-anomaly-alerts](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/spend-anomaly-alerts): Designs a daily ad account monitor: pacing, CPA, CPM and CTR spikes, zero-conversion spend and tracking drops, with history-based thresholds and a human approval queue.
- [competitor-watch-weekly](https://github.com/ua5er/user-acquisition-skills/tree/main/skills/competitor-watch-weekly): Weekly watch of competitor ads in public libraries and store pages: snapshots, week-over-week diff and a brief with new angles, survivors, price and paywall changes.
